system.description: Your close affinity with water release chakra, makes your innate control over it uniquely suited to deal with extremely aggressive foes. Once per turn, when you deal cold damage to a creature as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword, you can select one of the affected creatures to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you can choose to have either their speed reduced by 10 until the end of their next turn (This reduction becomes 20 at 7th and 30 at 15th level), or increase chakra damage they take by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. (This damage bonus increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.)
